Name: Auto Refresh Mine Shaft

[font=Arial][size=6][b][url=https://github.com/weizinai/StardewValleyMods/blob/main/AutoRefreshMineshaft/docs/README.md]中文介绍[/url][/b]
[b]Introduce[/b][/size]

[/font][font=Arial][size=3]In the vanilla multiplayer mode, when multiple players enter or exit the mine simultaneously, the mine levels often fail to refresh promptly, causing significant inconvenience for resource farming. This mod addresses the issue by ensuring that unoccupied mine levels are immediately reset whenever any player leaves the mine.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]The mod will only function correctly if all players have it installed.
[/size][/font][font=Arial]
